mapper.insert: insert into factory_making(USERUNIQUE, FACTORYTYPE, PLACE, STATUS, BEGINTIME, FINISHEDPERIOD, PAYMODE) values (#{userUnique}, #{factoryType}, #{place}, #{status}, #{beginTime}, #{finishedPeriod}, #{payMode});
mapper.select: select FACTORYID, USERUNIQUE, FACTORYTYPE, BEGINTIME, PLACE, FINISHEDPERIOD, PAYMODE, STATUS from factory_making where USERUNIQUE = #{userUnique};
